entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: ¶Dead flies putrefy the perfumer's ointment, And cause it to give off a foul odor; [So does] a little folly to one respected for wisdom [and] honor.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: A wise man's heart [is] at his right hand, But a fool's heart at his left.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: Even when a fool walks along the way, He lacks wisdom, And he shows everyone [that] he [is] a fool.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: ¶If the spirit of the ruler rises against you, Do not leave your post; For conciliation pacifies great offenses.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, As an error proceeding from the ruler:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: Folly is set in great dignity, While the rich sit in a lowly place.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants on horses, While princes walk on the ground like servants.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He who digs a pit will fall into it, And whoever breaks through a wall will be bitten by a serpent.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: He who quarries stones may be hurt by them, [And] he who splits wood may be endangered by it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the ax is dull, And one does not sharpen the edge, Then he must use more strength; But wisdom brings success.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: A serpent may bite when [it is] not charmed; The babbler is no different.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: ¶The words of a wise man's mouth [are] gracious, But the lips of a fool shall swallow him up;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The words of his mouth begin with foolishness, And the end of his talk [is] raving madness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: A fool also multiplies words. No man knows what is to be; Who can tell him what will be after him?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The labor of fools wearies them, For they do not even know how to go to the city!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: ¶Woe to you, O land, when your king [is] a child, And your princes feast in the morning!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Blessed [are] you, O land, when your king [is] the son of nobles, And your princes feast at the proper time-For strength and not for drunkenness!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: Because of laziness the building decays, And through idleness of hands the house leaks.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: A feast is made for laughter, And wine makes merry; But money answers everything.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Do not curse the king, even in your thought; Do not curse the rich, even in your bedroom; For a bird of the air may carry your voice, And a bird in flight may tell the matter.
